calls.head: Something has to give
calls.body: The Penguins are one of the league’s best for chance quality, and the Blue Jackets are near the top of the league at preventing dangerous shots. Our lean: the Penguins’ chance quality wins out.
calls.call: The Penguins’ chances are more dangerous than the league average (a 6.3% chance of scoring on the average shot) against the Blue Jackets.
calls.nums: Pittsburgh 3rd for chance quality (a 6.8% chance of scoring on the average shot) · Columbus 8th for preventing dangerous shots
calls.cite: Style fingerprint · this season blended with last · 4 and 2 games this season
calls.happened: On chance quality, Pittsburgh had 8.0% a shot. The league average is 6.3% a shot, and they came in at 6.8% a shot.

calls.head: The Penguins kill penalties far better than the Blue Jackets
calls.body: On the penalty kill, Pittsburgh is near the top of the league and Columbus is one of the league’s worst. That’s about as far apart as two teams get.
calls.call: The Penguins’ penalty kill allows less per 60 than the Blue Jackets’.
calls.cite: Style fingerprint · this season blended with last · 4 and 2 games this season
calls.happened: On expected goals allowed per 60 on the penalty kill, Pittsburgh had 7.3 per 60 and Columbus 0.0 per 60. Coming in, Pittsburgh was at 7.0 per 60 and Columbus at 8.6 per 60.

CBJ.head: We had this close to even (44% for Columbus), and Columbus came through.

PIT.head: We had this close to even (56% for Pittsburgh), and it went Columbus’s way.

surprises.head: Columbus shut down Pittsburgh’s power play
surprises.body: Pittsburgh’s power play created 0.0 expected goals per 60, against their usual 7.6 and a league average of 7.5. A team strays this far about once every 500 games.
surprises.flipped: The Penguins kill penalties far better than the Blue Jackets

surprises.head: A big night for S. Murashov
surprises.body: S. Murashov allowed 2 goals on shots worth 5.1 expected goals, 3.1 fewer than expected. Starting goalies had a night this good about once every 70 starts over the last three seasons.

story.head: The Blue Jackets win it in a shootout
paras: Damon Severson opened the scoring midway through the first. The Blue Jackets won it in the shootout.
The score was fair. Replay this game’s chances a hundred times and the Blue Jackets win about four in five.

items.text: The Penguins haven’t won in three.
One of the preview’s two calls held.
